|lore=An asteroid looming in one’s path can force a quick decision. One must choose, but choose wisely. This pilot chose poorly.
|game_text=Before any starting cards are revealed, deploy on table with up to 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Cards under here do not count toward your deck limit. Thrice per game, may lose 2 Force to play a Defensive Shield from here, as if from hand. Permanent weapons do not cause forfeit = 0; characters hit by them are forfeit –3 (may not be modified).

|notes=The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]], [[Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Revised (June 2003)]], and [[Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata 2)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The dated June 2003 revision defines the forfeit of characters hit by permanent weapons as printed forfeit minus 3, replacing the original wording which also barred modification. The December remaster retains the June formula, removes the 2-Force Shield play cost, and specifies five outside cards. The 19 June label belongs to the publisher’s download index. The August and February supplements confirm the June wording under Clarification. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf#page=3 Players Committee revised slip p. 3]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809111550id_/http://swccgpc.com:80/virtualcards.htm Players Committee dated download index]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040206210427id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet08252003.pdf#page=2 25 August 2003 rules supplement]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040707195107id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/rulessheet020904.pdf#page=3 9 February 2004 rules supplement].
